svg.title: The slowest requests disappear inside an average
svg.desc: Synthetic teaching example, not measurements or targets: 100 requests, with exact latencies of 100 ms for 60 requests, 200 ms for 25, 300 ms for 10, 600 ms for 4, and 1200 ms for 1. Nearest-rank P95 is 300 ms and P99 is 600 ms.
